tasks.subject: Create prompts directory with default templates
tasks.description: Create ~/.hermes/issue-queue/prompts/ with example prompt .md files. Add API endpoint to load them. Each file has a name (filename) and body with {{variables}}.

tasks.subject: Add backend APIs: issue detail, prompts list, agent dispatch
tasks.description: Add: GET /api/issue?repo=X&number=N (fetch full issue from GitHub), GET /api/prompts (list available prompt templates), POST /api/dispatch (spawn pi agent for an issue with selected prompt). Track spawned agents in queue item (agent_pid, agent_status, agent_log).
